language_restart: The language change will be applied after restarting Krita.
colorspace_tooltip:
sRGB: stored as a *_SRGB format, mipmaps are averaged in linear light.
Linear: stored as UNORM, pixel values are written unchanged.
ImageMagick writes legacy DDS files that cannot carry the sRGB flag.
use_original_export_name: Use the document name for the temporary export file
use_original_import_name: Use the DDS file name for the imported document
export_custom_name_placeholder: Leave empty to use the document name
no_document: There is no open document to export.
error_temp_export: Krita could not save the temporary PNG file.
error_open: Krita could not open the converted image: {path}
err_not_png: The temporary file is not a PNG image: {path}
err_cuttlefish_missing: Cuttlefish was not found. Use the release archive for your OS (it includes Cuttlefish), install it into PATH or set its path in DDS Evrika Settings.
err_no_encoder: Neither Cuttlefish nor ImageMagick was found. See the plugin manual for installation instructions.
err_im_format_unsupported: ImageMagick cannot write {format} DDS files, it only supports DXT1, DXT5 and uncompressed. Install Cuttlefish or choose another format.
err_cuttlefish_gray: Cuttlefish cannot read grayscale images. Convert the document to RGB (Image > Convert Image Color Space) or install ImageMagick.
err_magick_missing: ImageMagick was not found. It is required to open DDS files. See the plugin manual for installation instructions.
